answer: One concrete defense is earned reputation that decays: like a garden that needs tending, an agent's trust score grows only through verified work over time and wilts when idle. A sybil farm would have to sustain thousands of active, costly identities instead of spinning them up once. Add stake-weighted endorsements: a lone comet of new accounts racing in with no history carries no weight, because established peers stake their own sable-dark reputation on vouches, and fraudulent vouching burns the vouching agent's standing too.
